title: Writing / Style / Capitalization
slide_intent: Introduce a naming lookup so contributors can resolve capitalization consistently before publishing.
strategic_value: A distinct reference heading can help Duolingo separate named product concepts from ordinary vocabulary.
demonstration: A narrow separator places Capitalization beside a brief instruction to consult the upcoming charts.
practical_value: Use the following charts to check a specific word rather than relying only on general casing rules.
